page_title: FIO 1-1 TOR | Fiorentina v Torino 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Fiorentina is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+3' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90+3' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+2' Adam Masina (Torino) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but David de Gea easily deals with the threat.
90+2' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90+1' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' A clumsy foul by Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle. Torino have a free kick.
90' Here is a change. Andrea Colpani is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Christian Kouame (Fiorentina).
85' It is time for a substitution. Marcus Pedersen (Torino) is on for Yann Karamoh.

83' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
82' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Yellow card. Alieu Njie (Torino) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
78' It looks like Alieu Njie (Torino) saw red with that tackle. Livio Marinelli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
76' Substitution. Albert Gudmundsson will be replaced by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
76' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina).
75' The corner from Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) is cleared away by the defence.

70' 1 - 1 Goal! The ball breaks to Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 1:1.
69' The cross fools the defence and leaves Alieu Njie (Torino) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post.

68' A long pass finds Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
66' The ball possession is 53:47. The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:2. Shots on target – 5:1.
63' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) will take the corner.
62' Borna Sosa (Torino) is substituted due to injury. Paolo Vanoli gives a chance to Adam Masina.
62' Dodo (Fiorentina) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
60' Borna Sosa (Torino) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
60' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle after Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
58' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
57' Today's match ends for Nikola Vlasic who will be replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
57' That will be all from Adrien Tameze who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).

53' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is alert and denies him with a nice save.
50' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
48' Borna Sosa (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
47' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
46' Fiorentina get a corner.
46' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Torino comes to nothing.
45+2' Torino take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and it's Moise Kean (Fiorentina) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

44' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a great save.

43' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Yann Karamoh (Torino) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
38' 1 - 0 Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the top right corner, and thus alter the score to 1:0.
33' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and Ali Dembele (Torino) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
33' Livio Marinelli interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ali Dembele (Torino).
29' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
28' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) connects well with the free kick, but heads the ball just wide of the right post from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
27' Ali Dembele (Torino) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

27' Ali Dembele (Torino) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Livio Marinelli no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Fiorentina.
22' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) took the corner.
20' Saul Coco (Torino) brings his opponent down. Livio Marinelli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick.
19' Adrien Tameze (Torino) rises above the defence and heads the ball low, into the middle of the goal. The keeper is there waiting and denies him.
16' Saul Coco (Torino) sends a long cross over to Yann Karamoh, but David de Gea comes forward to gather the ball.

15' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
10' Andrea Colpani (Fiorentina) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
6' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
6' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
4' The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.
4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Dodo (Fiorentina), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Fiorentina have a corner.
2' Dangerous play by Borna Sosa (Torino). Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fiorentina will have the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
